data.one_liner: Foldable posture, hinge angle, and reserved screen regions for Android foldables and the iPhone Duo.
data.what_it_does: Provides fold posture, hinge angle, fold direction, and reserved screen regions like cameras and status pills for Android foldables and the iPhone Duo. Delivers data over an EventChannel and includes utility widgets like FoldSafeArea to keep content clear of hardware obstructions.
use_when: Building adaptive layouts for Android foldables and the iPhone Duo
Handling hinge angles, postures, and active folds in Flutter applications
Keeping content clear of cameras, status pills, and screen folds using custom safety widgets
avoid_when: Targeting platforms other than Android and iOS 27.1+
You only need basic responsive breakpoints without hardware foldable awareness
strengths: Supports both Android foldables and iOS 27.1+ iPhone Duo devices
Provides dedicated widgets like FoldSafeArea for padding content away from hardware cutouts
Tracks hinge angles, posturing, and active occlusion regions
weaknesses: Requires minimum iOS 15.0 and Xcode 27.1+ for iOS features
Flutter's own built-in iOS engine does not automatically populate MediaQuery.displayFeatures
data.setup_notes: Requires calling FoldableHelper.initialize() in main(), placing FoldableScope above MaterialApp, and forcing iOS deployment target to 15.0 in Podfile if necessary.
